x-realtime.authentication: HttpOnly session cookie, strict Origin, auth.csrfToken; never userId/room from client
x-realtime.semantics: Wake only after persisted notification commit; HTTP remains authoritative, scopes rechecked on every read; reconnect refetch + 30s HTTP reconciliation even while connected. Session expiry/revocation rechecked before wake and every 30s without extending inactivity. No client application events.
